evidence.quoted_text: const known = observation?.usage !== undefined && usage !== undefined;
evidence.reason: The current bulk settlement still marks a leg known solely from `report.usage` normalizing successfully; it never consults `report.usageSummary`. Because `address.ts` can aggregate partial measured usage into `report.usage` while recording unmeasured dispatches separately, the bulk path can settle a partial total as known and release its reservation, undercounting spend. Checking `report.usageSummary` for any unmeasured dispatch and falling back to the unknown-settlement path is the smallest compatible fix.
